observations: The page number «63» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The page has no signature. L01-L02 continue the example of the latitude of Saturn of p. 62 (JP2 0094, L31-L38): al-Battānī's rules give 2° 34′, al-Battānī's data with al-Khwārizmī's rules 2° 28′; Suter's computations are not given.

L11. Checked: 360° − 130° 24′ = 229° 36′. L03-L12: the argument 130° 24′ lies between 90° and 180°, where by the formula of p. 62 (JP2 0094, L11) the latitudo secunda decreases from its maximum, and the heading «latitudo Saturni recedentis» of the column of Table 31 is to be compared with the table.

L37-L40: the computation, set as a table: the names right-aligned before a column of signs of equality, the figures after them; «Summa :» below a rule under the figures, without a sign of equality. Each printed row is one line here, the cells separated by our «|»; the empty cells give the columns room and are not printed. Checked: 118° 15′ + 59° 27′ + 131° 1′ = 308° 43′; 118° 15′ is the argumentum examinatum of Venus of p. 54 (JP2 0086, L32), 131° 1′ the mean longitude of the sun of p. 42 rounded (p. 53, JP2 0085, N01). The latitudo prima 1p 15′ (Table 48) and the latitudo secunda 3° 54′ (Table 46) are to be compared with the tables.
L19-L20: Ptolemy's argument for the ratio, the true longitude increased by 50° for Saturn; note 1: al-Battānī takes the centrum instead of the true longitude.

L23: the v of «verschiedenen» and L28: the d of «die» are partly covered by grey blots of the scan, the letters legible; L20: a speck above the line between «wahren» and «Länge»; not transcribed. L36 and L41: «1p» with the p raised and italic, as on p. 62.

The dashes: L04 «115—116», L14 «58—59», L35 «15—17» long (39-47 px), with small gaps; L08, L11 and L12 the long dash with a space on either side; N02 «115—116» and «249—253», the long dash of the small type of the notes (31 px, with gaps of 5 and 9 px).

Spaced type, marked {sp:}: «Batt.», «Kh.», «Ptol.», «Nallino»; italics: «nördlich», «südlich» (L03, L05; upright in L12), «descendens,», «lat. sec.», «latitudo Saturni recedentis.», «Anomalia aequata», «latit. prima», «Latitudo secunda,», «untern», «Breite» (L28, L32), «Beispiel», «Venus» (L32; upright in L34), «Anomalia», «argumentum», «aequata», «latitud. sec.».
The colons and semicolons stand after the thin space of the edition (10-15 px measured; «obern ;» in L30, 11 px).
